storage-discovery-free-plan.title: A free Storage Discovery plan exists
storage-discovery-free-plan.body: This estimate uses the paid standard plan. The free plan covers capacity insights with 15 days of retention at no charge; the standard plan adds transaction, resource configuration and security configuration insights with 18 months of retention. Choose the free plan if capacity trends are all you need.

citation.quote: Azure Storage Discovery offers free and paid pricing plans.
